استبطنت (form X)
# اِسْتَبْطَنْتُ (istabṭantu) /is.tab.tˤan.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# اِسْتَبْطَنْتَ (istabṭanta) /is.tab.tˤan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# اِسْتَبْطَنْتِ (istabṭanti) /is.tab.tˤan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# اِسْتَبْطَنَتْ (istabṭanat) /i
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
